verbetes.glosa_atual: [ser suspenso, balançar; denominação. דֳּלִי; de onde]; tirar água.; שדֹּוֹלֶה ומ̇ש̇ק̇ה וכ' ele (Eliezer) tirou e deu de beber os ensinamentos de seu mestre.; tirar água, irrigar.
definicoes_originais: [ to be suspended, swing; denom. דֳּלִי; whence]
שדֹּוֹלֶה ומ̇ש̇ק̇ה וכ' he (Eliezer) drew and gave to drink of his master’s teachings.
(denom. of דָּלִית) to suspend, to train a plant to an espalier &c. Succ. I, 4 ה' עליה וכ' if he trained a vine over the festive wreath.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 93; Cant. R. to I, 1. Ex. R. s. 1 אנשים דּוֹלִים וכ' men draw the water and women water the flock; a. fr.—Yoma 28 b (play on ד̇מ̇ש̇ק̇, Gen. XV,
—2) to lift up, relieve. Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 3 וכשיִדְלֵנִי וכ' and when the Lord shall lift me up out of the depths of suffering. Cant. R. to II, 1.
B. Kam. 51 b המַדְלֶה מים וכ' he who draws water (to irrigate his field &c.); ואני אַדְלֶה and I will &c.; a. fr.

Kil. VI, 4; a. fr.— Part. pass. מוּדְלֶה, f. מוּדְלָה. Ib. Midd. III, 8. Y. B. Mets. X, 12 c, v. דָּלִית.—Bab. ib. 91 b במוּדָלוֹת Ms. F. (ed. במודלית) when figs and grapes overhang one another. [Y. Shebi. II, 33 c bot. מודלה, v. מִדְלַעַת.]
Part. מְדַלֶּה, pl. מְדַלִּין. M. Kat. 4 a sq., v. דָּלַל.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; ser suspenso.; desenhar, aumentar.; para levantar.
notas_originais: Part. pl. דַּלְיָין suspended. Targ. Esth. I, 6.
Targ. Ex. II, 19. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 buckets דדלו אבנא which draw stone; a. fr. [Targ. Y. Num. XIV, 14 read מַדְלֵי Af.] [Pes. 40 a מדלייהו, v. מַדְלָא.]

B. Kam. 92 b דַּלְיַת, דְּלִינָא, v. דּוּרָא IV.—Ber. 18 a דַּלְיֵיה (Yalk. Koh. 979; Yalk. Sam. 152 סלקיה) lift it (the cloak) up. Kidd. 81 a דַלְיֵיה וכ' he carried it by himself.—Yeb. 92 b; B. Mets. 17 b אי לאו דדְלָאִי לך וכ' had I not taken up (removed) the sherd for thee, thou wouldst never have found the pearl under it, i.e. but for my intimation you would not have reached the conclusion &c.; Macc. 21 b.—M. Kat. 28 b, v. דְּלַל.

Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 51 ולא דַּלּוּ מיניה (Var. דָּלוּ, fr. דְּלַל) and they would not relieve him (give him a respite). Ib. דַּלִּי מיני (Var. דְּלִי) respite me.—Meg. 13 a דַּלֵּי כרגא he lightened the taxes (Esth. II, 18).
Ber. 6 b דַּלּוּיֵי lifting up the voice at funerals, v. דְּלַל.
Sot. 34 a טעונא דמַדְלֵי וכ' a load which one can lift up and put on his shoulders, is the third portion of the weight he can carry.
Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15 d, a. e. בגדך מִדְּלֵי (sub. אַתְּ) doest thou depend on thy good luck?, v. גַּדָּא.
Pes. 8 a דמִידַּלְיָא (a bed) which stands on high legs (leaving space under it).
B. Bath. 16 b; Yalk. Gen. 106 (prov.) (מִידְּלֵי) א' יומא א' קצירא when the day (sun) is high, the sick man is relieved.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (דלל, cmp. דִּלְדֵּל) qualquer coisa enrolada irregularmente, emaranhada; reboque, carvalho & c. B. Kam. II, 1 היה ד' קשור וכ' (Sra. M. a. Var. notou no comentário. דֳּלִי) se os pés do galo estavam emaranhados etc. Ib.
definicoes_originais: (דלל, cmp. דִּלְדֵּל) anything irregularly wound, tangle; tow, oakum &c. B. Kam. II, 1 היה ד' קשור וכ' (Ms. M. a. Var. noticed in comment. דֳּלִי) if the cock’s feet were entangled &c. Ib.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (דלע, cmp. דֳּלִי a. זְלוּעַ) [em forma de garrafa,] cabaça, um nome geral para pepinos, abóboras etc. (v. Sm. Ant. s. vv. Colocynthe a. Colocynthis).
definicoes_originais: (דלע, cmp. דֳּלִי a. זְלוּעַ) [ bottle-shaped,] gourd, a general name for cucumbers, pumpkins &c. (v. Sm. Ant. s. vv. Colocynthe a. Colocynthis).
notas_originais: Kil. I, 2 ד' מצרית וכ' Ms. M. (ed. המצרי, corr. acc.) Egyptian gourd and the Bitter-gourd may be planted together (v. כִּלְאַיִם). Ned. VI, 1 דלעת הרמוצה, variously explained ib. 51 a; Y. Kil. I, 27 a top; a. fr.—Sot. 16 a מגלחו כד' he shaves his body as smooth as a gourd; Y. Kidd. I, 59 d top כדלת (corr. acc.). Pl. דִּלּוּעִים, דִּלּוּעִין, דּילּ'. Sabb. XXIV, 4. Ned. VII, 1; a. fr.—Tosef. Maasr. III, 14 דִּלּוּעוֹת.—Erub. 104 a דְּלָעָיו, v. מִדְלַעַת.
Bekh. 44 a his eyes are דומעות דּוֹלְפוֹת וכ' tearing, dripping or running.

notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XIX, 13 דָּלֵף (Var. דָּלֵיף).—Sabb. 43 a דשכיחי דדַלְפֵי which are liable to have leaky roofs.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (δελφική = δέλφιξ, delphica, sub. mensa) delphica, uma mesa de três pernas usada como toalete ou garçom, contrad. frag. שלחן mesa de jantar (v. Becker Gallus, ed. Göll II, p. 354).
definicoes_originais: (δελφική = δέλφιξ, delphica, sub. mensa) delphica, a three-legged table used as a toilet table or a waiter, contrad. fr. שלחן eating table (v. Becker Gallus, ed. Göll II, p. 354).
notas_originais: Kel. XXV, 1. Ib. XXII, 1; Tosef. ib. B. Bath. I, 9 דולפני (corr. acc.). Ab. Zar. V, 5 (69 a) דלפ' Ar. (Ms. M. דלוב', ed. דולב', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). Y. Dem. VI, 25 d statuary made כמין ד' like a kind of delphica (for practical use and not for idol worship, cmp. בָּסִיס). *Ex. R. s. 43 מגפפת לד' hugging the statuary figure supporting a delphica (Num. R. s. 2 סריס).— Pl. דְּלִפְקִיּוֹת. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42 c bot.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); queimar; ser iluminado.; perseguir ansiosamente.; ser queimado, destruído pelo fogo.
definicoes_originais: to be burnt, destroyed by fire.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 39 saw a castle דּוֹלֶקֶת lighted. B. Kam. VI, 5 ודָלְקוּ and they caught fire. Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4 c והיא דְלֵיקָה והולכת that it may continue to burn. Ib. d דְּלֵיקִין are burning.—Part. pass. דָּלוּק enkindled, burning. Gen. R. s. 11 מצאתי אותו דָ' (Yalk. ib. 16 דּוֹלֵק) I found it still burning. Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, 14 (ref. to לדלקים ib.) שלבם דָּ' עליהם (Yalk. a. l. דולק) whose hearts within them are burning (with lust).—Lam. R. to IV, 19 [read:] שהיו דולקין אחריהם מַעֲבִיּוֹת (Koh. R. to V, 2 שמשליכין דֶּלֶק אחריהם) they (the Romans) sent fire after them from their engines (tormenta), v. עָבִית.
Lam. R. l. c. דּוֹלְקֵיהֶם של ישראל (Koh. R. l. c. רודפ'; Midr. Till. l. c. שונאין) Israel’s persecutors.
Orl. III, 1 יִדָּלֵק; יִּדָּלְקוּ must be burnt. Ib. 2 sq.; a. fr.—Y. B. Kam. IV, 5 c top דרכן לִידָּלֵק liable to take fire.

Sabb. II, 1 במה מַדְלִיקִין what material may be used for the Sabbath lights? Ib. 7 הַדְלִיקיּ וכ' light the lamps. Y. ib. II, 4 c bot.; Y. Ter. XI, 48 b top באה להַדְלִיק וכ' she came to get a light from a priest’s wife; a. fr.—V. הַדְלָקָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ;; queimar.; para acender uma luz, acenda um fogo.; para perseguir.
definicoes_originais: to kindle a light, start a fire.
notas_originais: Targ. Am. V, 6; a. e.—Meg. 12 b דַּלְקָה ביה חמתיה Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) = חמתו בערה בו (Esth. I, 12).—2) to pursue, v. infra.

Targ. Num. VIII, 2. Targ. Ex. XXII, 5; a. e.—Sabb. 22 b ואַדְלוּקֵי and kindle (the chip). Ib. bot. לצורכו הוא דאַדְלְקָהּ he lighted it for his use. Ib. 23 a מַדְלִיקֵי עלי וכ' they light the Ḥanuckah lamps in my behalf at home; a. e.
Targ. Lam. IV, 19. [Ib. III, 66 תַּדְלוֹק', read תִּדְלֹוק' or תַּדְלִיק'.]

notas_originais: Y. Sabb. II, beg., 4 c לא הוצת האור ברוב הד' the larger portion of the burning material was not enkindled (on the entrance of the Sabbath). Midd. I, 4 שער הד' the Temple gate by which the burning material was brought in. Koh. R. to V, 2, v. דָּלַק.
, v. כּוֹלֶּקְטָרִין
Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 a bot.
, v. דְּלֵיקְתָּא

verbetes.glosa_atual: Daleth, a quarta letra do Alfabeto.
definicoes_originais: Daleth, the fourth letter of the Alphabeth.
notas_originais: Sabb. 104 a, v. גימ"ל. Y. ib. VII, 10 d top היה ד' וכ' if one changed a Daleth into a Resh. Maas. Sh. IV, 11 ד' דמאי the mark Daleth intimates that the contents are D’mai (v. דְּמַאי); Tosef. ib. V, 1; Y. ib. IV, 55 b top. Y. Snh. X, 28 b top; a. fr.— Pl. דַּלְ"תִים, דַּלְ"תִין. Sifré Deut. 36; Sabb. 103 b

Erub. 101 a, v. אַלְמָנָה.—נעל ד' בפני לוין to shut the door to borrowers, to render credit difficult. Snh. 32 a; a. fr.—B. Kam. 80 b ד' הננעלת וכ' a door once shut is not easily opened, i.e. it requires ardent prayer to regain divine grace after a calamity has set in; a. fr.—Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 7 של ד' on hinges, v. מַסְחֵיט.— Pl. דְּלָתוֹת, constr. דַּלְתוֹת. Sabb. XVII, 1. Lev. R. s. 14 יש ד' וכ' a woman’s womb has doors (muscles, ref. to Job III, 10); a. fr.—Par. III, 2; Tosef. ib. III (II), 2 על גביהן ד' a seat of boards on hinges upon the backs of the oxen; Succ. 21 a.—Yoma 9 b כד' vacillating like doors, v. דַּלּוּת. [Y. Kidd. I, 59 d top, v. דְּלַעַת.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: . Targ. Jó III, 9 (10) דלתתי דהנון דשי, um glossário para פאתי ou פרתי. [Ed. Atraso. דלסתי; Sra.
notas_originais: . Targ. Job III, 9 (10) דלתתי דהנון דשי, a gloss to פאתי or פרתי. [Ed. Lag. דלסתי; Ms. וליסתיי.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Targ. Prov. XIX, 14 var. (v. ed. Lag. II, p. XII 4), uma corrupção de ירותתא.
notas_originais: , Targ. Prov. XIX, 14 Var. (v. ed. Lag. II, p. XII 4), a corruption of ירותתא.

דַּם (b. h.; דום or דמם, cmp. דבב) liquid; blood; life. Men. 44 a בדָמוֹ (not בדמה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) with the juice of the purple shell.—Sabb. 31 b רביעית ד' וכ' one fourth of a Log of blood did I (the Lord) put in your body (the smallest quantity required to sustain life, v. Sot. 5 a). Snh. 72 b (ref. to Gen. IX, 6) הצל דָּמוֹ וכ' save the life of the one (who is pursued) at the expense of the life of the other (the pursuer).—דַּם ברית = ד' של מילה the blood lost at circumcision. Tosef. Sabb. XV (XVI), 9 צריך להטיף … ד' ב' he must cause the blood of the covenant to flow from him (even if born without preputium). Ib. 8; a. fr.—Pes. 16 b ד' שהנפש וכ' the blood with which life escapes when cutting the animal’s throat is called a fluid (with regard to levitical purity, v. כָּשַׁר); a. v. fr.— Pl. דָּמִים. Keth. 9 b טענת ד' complaint of absence of the token of virginity.—שְׁפִיכוּת ד' (abbr. ש"ד) murder. Yoma 67 b; a. fr.—Midd. III, 1, a. e. ד' העליונים blood sprinkled against the upper part of the altar, opp. ד' התחתונים.—Snh. VIII, 6, a. fr. (with ref. to Ex. XXII,
יש לו ד' his blood is revenged, אין לו ד' may be killed with impunity. Ib. 72 a בד' קננהו he acquired possession of them by risking his life.—[דָּמִים equivalent, v. דָּמִים.)

Targ. O. Gen. IV, 10. Targ. ib. IX, 6; a. fr.—B. Bath. 58 b בריש כל מרעין אנא ד' וכ' at the head of all diseases (chief cause of physical disorders) am I, the blood. Yoma 82 b, a. e. מאי חזית דד' דידך וכ' what right hast thou to assume that thy blood is redder than thy neighbor’s (you have no right to commit murder even under compulsion). Kidd. 81 a נשויתיה (שויתי) לָדָמָךְ וכ' I should have valued thy life two M’ah, i.e. I should not have spared thee; Pes. 112 b Ms. M. (ed. סכנתיך, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200, a. note 3). Keth. 60 b bot. על דמא דחמרא Ar. s. v. גרדן (ed. רמא) on the blood of an ass.— Pl. דְּמֶי. Targ. Gen. IV, 11; a. fr.—Gitt. 57 b, v. דְּמֵי I.
Ab. Zar. 28 b; Bets. 22 a ד' דמעתא וכ' congestion of the eye, tears &c. Gitt. 68 b לד' דרישא for congestion of the head (head-ache). [דְּמֵי equivalent, v. דָּמִין.] V. אִדְמָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Dama, nome de um gentio de Ascalon, elogiado por sua reverência filial.
definicoes_originais: Dama, name of a gentile of Ascalon, praised for his filial reverence.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 23 b (Var. רמא, רמה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90); Kidd. 31 a; Y. Peah I, 15 c top דָּמָה; Yalk. Ex. 364. Cmp. דּוּמָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (דמי) suspeita, conversa, de onde (cmp. דּוּמָה, שְׁתוֹקִי) D’mai, frutas sobre as quais há suspeita de que os dízimos delas tenham sido devidamente retirados, opp. וַדַּאי.
definicoes_originais: (דמי) suspicion, talk, whence (cmp. דּוּמָה, שְׁתוֹקִי) D’mai, fruits about which there is a suspicion as to the tithes therefrom being properly taken, opp. וַדַּאי.
notas_originais: Y. Maas. Sh. V, end, 56 d [read:] דמאי דְּמַי תיקן דְּמַי לא תיקן D’mai means, There is a talk that he has given the tithes, there is a talk that he has not; Y. Sot. IX, 24 b top ומי לא תיקן (read דְּמַי). Y. Dem. II, 22 a top; Y. Shek. V, 48 d top ארימתון דְּמַיָּין have you set apart what is due of them (the barley) according to the law of D’mai?—Dem. I, 1. Ib. 3 פטור מן הד' is exempt from the law of D’mai (no tithes required of them on account of doubt); a. fr.— D’mai, name of a treatise of Mishnah, Tosefta a. Y’rushalmi of the Order of Z’raïm. [Not to be confounded with דְּמַאי = ד־מאי of what.]
m. pl. (דמי, v. P. Sm. 913 sq.) figures. Targ. Jud. XVII, 5; XVIII, 14; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , pl. דִּמְדּוּמִין, (דַּמַם) דִּי' paralisação, quietude; דִּמְדּוּמֵי חמה o horário da manhã e da noite em que o sol parece estar parado ou silencioso (cmp. Yoma 20 b), amanhecer e pôr do sol.
definicoes_originais: , pl. דִּמְדּוּמִין, (דַּמַם) דִּי' stand-still, stillness; דִּמְדּוּמֵי חמה the time in the morning and the evening when the sun appears to stand still or be silent (cmp. Yoma 20 b), dawn and sunset.
notas_originais: Sabb. 118 b; Ber. 29 b; a. fr. Y. Pes. V, beg. 31 c ד' החמה sunset.
Part. pass. מְדוּמְדָּם unable to speak, overcome by wine. Y. Ter. I, 40 d bot.
Part. pass. מְדַמְדַּם overwhelmed. Cant. R. to III, 4 הוה מ' וכ' he lay in a stupor the whole night, opp. פרפר to be restless.
Targ. Y. II Ex. XV, 16 [read:] יִדַּ'.
, v. דַּבְדְּבָנִיּוֹת (cmp. דָּם).
pr. n. m., v. דָּמָא
, v. דמי
R. Hash. 21 a. Erub. 6 a רמה' Ms. M. (ed. דמח'). Men. 81 a Ms. M. (ed. דַּמְהוּרְיָא). V. Berl. Beitr. z. Geogr. p. 30.

verbetes.glosa_atual: f. = דְּמוּתָא. Targ. Y. Deut. V, 8. Targ. O. Ex. XX, 4 ed. Berlim.; um. frag.
notas_originais: f. = דְּמוּתָא. Targ. Y. Deut. V, 8. Targ. O. Ex. XX, 4 ed. Berl.; a. fr.

notas_originais: m. same. Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 4; a. e.
, v. דְּמַךְ
Targ. Esth. II, 21 בית ד' bed-room.

notas_originais: , Targ. Prov. VI, 31 Ms. (ed. מזלא), read מוֹדְלָא.

, v. דִּימּ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: semelhança, imagem, esp. imagem divina do homem (Gen. I, 26).
definicoes_originais: resemblance, image, esp. man’s divine image (Gen. I, 26).
notas_originais: Yeb. 63 b כאילו ממעט הד' as though he diminished the divine image (by neglecting the propagation of man). Num. R. s. 19 מדמין ד' גבורה של מעלה וכ' they compare the appearance of Divinity to the shape of man; a. fr.— Pl. דְּמוּיוֹת. Pesik. R. s. 33 כמה ד' נדמיתי וכ' in how many images (visions) did I appear to you!—Yalk. Ex. 422 שני ד' אחד וכ'(!) two embroidered designs, one on each side.
Targ. O. Ex. XX, 4 (v. דְּמוּ). Targ. O. Deut. IV, 15 sq.; a. e.—Pesik. Parah, p. 41 a כדְמוּתֵיה אנא וכ' whenever I see a vision resembling him &c.; Pesik. R. s. 14 בדמותיה (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Difel de מְחַמַר, v. חֲמַר I, a. דְּ־) aquilo que está arruinado; ruínas, escombros.
definicoes_originais: (Difel of מְחַמַר, v. חֲמַר I, a. דְּ־) that which is ruined; ruins, debris.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. XXIII, 13; XXV, 2 (h. text מפלה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. murmurar, pensar (cmp. דבב); ficar em silêncio.; imaginar, comparar.; (denominação de דְּמוּת) assemelhar-se, ser semelhante, imitar.
definicoes_originais: to mumble, think (cmp. דבב); to be silent.
(denom. of דְּמוּת) to resemble, be like, to imitate.
to be compared, to be imagined; to appear in the disguise of; to seem.
to have an opinion without authority to refer to.
notas_originais: Denom. (דִּימָה,) דָּמוּת.
Denom. דְּמוּת.

Sabb. 133 b הוי דֹומֶה לו imitate Him. Ber. 29 b שתפלתו דֹומָה עליו וכ' to whom his prayer appears like a burden. Taan. 22 b אין דורו דומה יפה (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) his generation was not considered worthy. B. Kam. 92 b; Yalk. Jud. 67 ובן אדם לדו' לו (not ובני) and man associates with his equal. Sifra Sh’mini Par. 10, ch. XII; Ḥull. 76 b הַדֹּומֶה that which resembles the animal specified in the Bible (species); הד' לַדֹּומֶה what resembles the animal classified with the animal specified in the Bible (genus); a. fr.—אֵינֹו דֹומֶה there is no resemblance, you cannot compare. Yeb. 64 a א' ד' תפלת … לתפלת וכ' you cannot compare the prayer of … to the prayer of &c. Sabb. 119 b; a. fr.—Hull. 48 b זו דֹומָה לזו these are analogous cases, v. Pi.—(משל) למה הדבר דומה (abbrev. מלה"ד, לה"ד) (a simile:) to what can this be compared?, a phrase introducing a simile. Taan. 25 b. Yoma 86 b; a. v. fr.

Kidd. 32 b כמה"ש נִדְמוּ לו that they appeared to him as ministering angels; נדמו לו לערביים they appeared to him as if they were Arabs. Succ. 52 a צדיקים נ' להם כהר וכ' to the righteous sin will appear like a high mount; a. fr.—נִדְמֶה an animal suspected to be a hybrid or looking like one (cmp. דְּמַאי), esp. a lamb looking like a kid, and vice versa. Bekh. 12 a ‘a ewe which gave birth to what looked like a kid’. Ḥull. 38 b; a. fr.
Lev. R. s. 32 דִּמִּיתִיךָ להם I made thee like them (beasts). B. Bath. 130 b ובלבד שלא יְדַמֶּה וכ' but one must not decide ritual cases by analogy; v. Ḥull. 48 b

Gitt. 19 a; 37 a מפני שאנו מְדַמִּין because we have such an opinion.— Part. pass. מְדוּמֶּה, pl. מְדוּמִּין; כמ' אני it seems to me, כמ' אנו it seems to us &c. Men. 18 a. Taan. 23 a; a. fr.—Y. Ber. II, 5 b bot. כמ' הייתי I thought.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; ser burro.; imaginar, suspeitar, considerar, Targ. I Reis VIII, 27 דָּמֵי (incorr. חמי).; para comparar.
definicoes_originais: to imagine, suspect, consider, Targ. I Kings VIII, 27 דָּמֵי (incorr. חמי).
to be like, to take an example.
to appear in the disguise of.
notas_originais: Targ. Hab. II, 19 דַּמְיָא (some ed. incorr. ר').

—Part. act. a. pass. דָּמֵי suspected, considered; resembling, like.—Yeb. 114 b אמרה בדְדָמֵי she speaks of what was to be suspected (under the circumstances, though she has not seen it).—שפיר דמי it is considered as right, it is right. Ab. Zar. 38 b ש' ד' it is all right (is permitted). Ber. 13 b הא מיגנא ש' ד' but to lie (on the back) is permitted; a. v. fr.—Ber. 25 b כוליה ביתא … ד' the entire house is to be considered (for legal purposes) as four cubits. Ib. 4 b כתפלה אריכתא דַמְיָא is to be considered as one continued prayer, v. אֲרִיכָא; a. fr.—היכי דמי (abbrev. ה"ד) what is it like? in what case? Yeb. 63 b ה"ד אשה רעה what do you call ‘a bad wife’? Sabb. 4 a ה"ר אילימא וכ' what case do you mean? Do you mean the case of an involuntary transgressor &c.?; a. v. fr.—Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 32, v. Pa.—Erub. 54 a כהלולא ד' is like a wedding feast (soon passing away). B. Kam. 85 a דַּמְיַת עלי כאריא וכ', v. אֲרַב. Taan. 21 b דַּמְיָין מעייהו ל־ their entrails look like those of human beings; a. fr.—Pes. 14 b, a. fr. מי דָמֵי is this like (the other)?, i.e. there is no analogy between them.

Targ. Is. XL, 25; a. fr.—Ḥull. 55 b, a. e. טרפות קא מְדַמְּיַת להדדי you compare cases of T’refoth to one another (form an analogy)? (v. preced. Pi.). Snh. 47 a מי קא מדמית וכ' can you compare &c.?—Part. pass. מְדַמֵּי, f. מְדַמְיָא, pl. מְדַמְיָין. Targ. Y. II Deut. XXXII, 32 sq. (Y. I דמי').
Targ. Jud. XI, 23. Targ. Is. XLV, 9; a. e.

Targ. Prov. VI, 6 אִתְדְּמֵא וכ' imitate the ant (ed. Vien. אִתְרְמֵי, read אתד'). Targ. Ps. CII, 7; a. e.—Y. Shek. IV, 48 d top; Y. Dem. I, 21 d bot. לא אִידְּמִינָן we cannot compare ourselves. Gitt. 57 b אייתו דמי ולא אִידְּמוּ they brought blood of animals but it did not look like (the blood of the prophet); a. fr.
Kidd. 81 a … אי' ליה שטן כ Satan appeared to him as a woman &c. Ib. 29 b אי' ליה וכ' (a demon) appeared to him as a monster &c. Snh. 95 a אד'; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: por favor. do Pl. de דְּמָא.; valor, v.

notas_originais: , v. דְּמַאי
, v. דֹּומִיטְ'
דְּמִיכַת f. (דמך) sleep. Targ. Koh. V, 11.

דְּמֵי (דמה) equivalent, compensation; (cmp. שָׁוָה) price, value; payment. Pes. 112 b do not bargain בשעה שאין לך ד' when thou hast no money to pay with. Kerith. 13 b ד' וערכין the assessment of an object to be redeemed or of an object the value of which was dedicated, v. עֶרֶךְ.—Pes. 32 a לפי מידה … או לפי ד' וכ' must he pay the fine according to quantity or according to value?—Kidd. I, 6 כל הנעשה ד' באחר whatever is used as payment for another object; expl. ib. 28 a כל הנישום ד' וכ' whatever is assessed as an equivalent, i.e. an exchange is meant and not a sale for cash. Ib. b החליף דמי שור בפרה if he gives a cow in payment of money which he owes for an ox; a. fr.—Keth. 103 b נהוג נשיאותך בד' Ar. conduct thy office of Nasi as something valuable (Var. in Ar., a. ed. ברָמִים).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , constr. דְּמֵי cap. mesmo. Targ. Lam. V, 4 (h. texto מְחִיר); um. frag.-B. Mets. 5 b ele pensa (como uma reserva mental) דמי קא יהבנא ליה Estou disposto a compensá-lo. Ib. לא תחמוד לאינשי בלא ד' משמע להו as pessoas comuns entendem o
notas_originais: , constr. דְּמֵי ch. same. Targ. Lam. V, 4 (h. text מְחִיר); a. fr.—B. Mets. 5 b he thinks (as a mental reservation) דמי קא יהבנא ליה I am willing to compensate him. Ib. לא תחמוד לאינשי בלא ד' משמע להו common people understand the law, ‘thou shalt not covet’ (Ex. XX, 16) to mean coveting to get our neighbor’s property without compensation. B. Kam. 46 a אי דְּמֵי רדיא וכ' if he paid the market price of a ploughing ox, he surely bought him for ploughing; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (ou דְּמִין) pr. n. por favor. Damin (D'min), mais tarde mame de Ădami (Josh. XIX, 33).
definicoes_originais: (or דְּמִין) pr. n. pl. Damin (D’min), later mame of Ădami (Josh. XIX, 33).
notas_originais: Y. Meg. I, 70 a bot.

verbetes.glosa_atual: dormir; morrer, deitar na sepultura.; sentir a aproximação da morte.
definicoes_originais: to sleep; to die, to lie in the grave.
to feel the approach of death.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. III, 6. Ib. IV, 9; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 72, beg. עמך הוא דמיך he (Jacob) will lie with thee in the grave. Ib. s. 91, a. fr. כד ד' וכ' when R. … was dead; a. v. fr.—Ruth R. to III, 13; Koh. R. to VII, 8 ודַמְכַת לה and the fire over the grave died out.
same. Targ. Koh. V, 11. Targ. Job III, 13, some ed.—Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55 c top וההוא גברא יתיב מְדַמַּךְ (not מדרך) and this man (I, thou) dreamt that he was sitting and sleeping.
Y. Kil. IX, 32 c bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b
Targ. Ps. CXXXII, 4. Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 16; a. e.— Pl. דַּמְכִין. Targ. Ps. CXLIX, 5 דַּמכיהון Ms. (ed. דִּמְ') their resting places.
Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42 c top.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v.דּוּם, דָּמָה); ficar calado, mudo, em repouso; ficar mudo.; parar.; silenciar, parar.
definicoes_originais: to be silent, dumb, at rest; to be stricken dumb.
to silence, bring to a stand-still.
notas_originais: Pesik. R. s. 33 (ref. to Is. VI, 5) היאך היה לי שדָּמַמְתִּי how did it happen to me that I was silent (did not join in the praises of the angels)? Taan. 20 a דָּמְמוּ הרוחות when the winds subside. Snh. 91 a כאבן דּוּמָם like a dumb stone. Ber. 19 a יושב ודֹומֵם sits in silence; a. fr.— Part. pass. דָּמוּם, f. דְּמוּמָה. Lam. R. to I, 17 (ref. to אֶדַּדֵּם, Ps. XLII, 5) ועכשיו ד' סלקא וכ' and now in silence does she (Israel) go up (to the ruins of Jerusalem), and in silence &c.—V. דִּמְדֵּם.
Midr. Till. to Ps. IV, 5 (ref. to ודמו ib.) [read:] ובלבד שתִּדֹּום וכ' provided that thou leavest off from the sin &c.; Yalk. ib. 627.
Ex. R. s. 29 end ה' כל העולם He made the world stand still. Gen. R. s. 97 שהוא מַדְמִים וכ' who will bring to a standstill sun and moon.
Y. Bicc. III, 65 d כד מסקום read בד' in D.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) fluir, derramar lágrimas.; (denominação de דֶּמַע II) para fazer algo, de outra forma isento, sujeito à lei de T’rumah, para misturar grãos seculares, vinho, óleo etc. com T’rumah em proporções suficientes para tornar tudo proibido a não-sacerdotes; em geração. misturar coisas seculares com sagradas.; para se tornar Dema através da mistura.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of דֶּמַע II) to make a thing, otherwise exempt, subject to the law of T’rumah, to mix secular grain, wine, oil &c. with T’rumah in proportions sufficient to make the whole prohibited to non-priests; in gen. to mix secular with sacred things.
notas_originais: Tosef. Bekh. IV, 4 אם … דֹומַעַת if his eye is tearing. Bekh. 44 a, v. דָּלַף. [Sifré Deut. 157 עד שיהו … דומעות, read: שזלגו עיניו דְּמָעֹות; v. Sot. VII, 8.]

Orl. II, 4; 6 המְדַמֵּעַ; a. fr.—Ter. III, 1 אינה מְדַמַּעַת וכ' does not make Dema by itself (if mixed with secular fruits). Ib. 2 אינה מְדַמֵּעֲתָן does not make them dema; מְדַמְּעֹות כקטנה וכ' make dema, the smallest of the two being considered as an admixture; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְדוּמָּע. Ib. V, 6 אין המדומע מדמע וכ' that which became subject to the law of T’rumah through an admixture, can affect a second mixture only in proportion, i.e. according to the quantity of real T’rumah contained therein. Ḥag. III, 4 wine jars or oil jars המְדוּמָּעֹות which have been mixed up; expl. ib. 25 b מד' דקדש containing liquids, a portion of which was designated for libations.
Ter. l. c. Nidd. 46 b עיסה שנִדְמְעָה if a sufficient quantity of T’rumah has been put in a dough to make it forbidden to non-priests; a. e.
Targ. Jer. XIII, 17 (some ed. דַמַּע … Pa.). Targ. Lam. II, 18.
Men. 30 a; B. Bath. 15 a Moses wrote בד' (Ms. M. בדְמָעֹות) with tears (so that he could not speak).— Pl., v. דִּמְעָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: frutas, de onde (sub. רֵאשִׁית, מַתְּנַת, v. Ex. XXII, 28) a parte do sacerdote nos produtos, T'rumah.
definicoes_originais: fruits, whence (sub. רֵאשִׁית, מַתְּנַת, v. Ex. XXII, 28) the priest’s share of the produces, T’rumah.
notas_originais: Mekh. Mishp. s. 19; Yalk. Ex. 351 T’rumah has three names, Reshith, T’rumah וד' and Dema; Tem. 4 a. Ohol. XVI, 4 אוכל בדִמְעֹו he may partake of his priestly share. Tosef. Ter. X, 16 בית הד' place in the barn designated for T’rumah.
